skills.name: mbse-systems-engineering
skills.short_description: Understand systems and reason through engineering decisions
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-systems-engineering to understand this system problem, question consequential assumptions, connect the disciplines, and explain a defensible recommendation.

skills.name: mbse-system-concept
skills.short_description: Explore feasible system concepts and alternatives
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-system-concept to frame the problem in this brief, compare meaningful alternatives, and explain the preferred direction and its open feasibility questions.

skills.name: mbse-conops
skills.short_description: Connect stakeholder needs to real operating conditions
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-conops to explain how this system will be used, reconcile stakeholder responsibilities, and develop the operating concept and unresolved decisions.

skills.name: mbse-operational-scenarios
skills.short_description: Develop normal, exception, and recovery scenarios
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-operational-scenarios to work through this operation, including exceptions and recovery, and identify observations that could change its design.

skills.name: mbse-requirements
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-requirements to interpret these stakeholder inputs, resolve conflicting meanings, and draft traceable requirements with acceptance conditions and open decisions.

skills.name: mbse-architecture
skills.short_description: Reason about functions, structure, and interfaces
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-architecture to connect this system’s behavior to alternative structures, explain the tradeoffs, and develop allocations and interface contracts.

skills.name: mbse-verification-evidence
skills.short_description: Connect engineering claims to credible evidence
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-verification-evidence to determine what evidence would establish these claims, assess the supplied results, and develop the remaining verification and validation work.

skills.name: mbse-baseline-review
skills.short_description: Challenge a baseline and explain change impacts
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-baseline-review to examine this baseline or change, explain consequential mismatches, and identify repairs and decisions supported by the evidence.

skills.name: mbse-aerospace
skills.short_description: Reason about aircraft and space system decisions
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-aerospace to reason through this aircraft or space system question, identify the applicable program context, and explain the design and assurance implications.

skills.name: mbse-defense
skills.short_description: Connect mission outcomes to system and lifecycle choices
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-defense to connect this mission need to system behavior, organizational interfaces, acquisition constraints, and evidence for the next decision.

skills.name: mbse-automotive
skills.short_description: Reason about vehicle behavior and lifecycle assurance
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-automotive to explain this vehicle-system problem and connect operating conditions, driver behavior, architecture, safety, security, and evidence.

skills.name: mbse-medical-device
skills.short_description: Connect intended use, device design, and patient risk
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-medical-device to reason through this device question from intended use, connect risks to design choices, and identify the evidence and decisions still needed.

skills.name: mbse-electronic-systems
skills.short_description: Reason about electronics, interfaces, and verification
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-electronic-systems to explain this hardware-system problem, reconcile physical and software assumptions, and identify design choices and meaningful verification.
